name: Yaro-Tomo! ~Days Which Ran in School Life~
original_name: やろとも!～Days which ran in school life～
source:
Summer arrives. 
The daily lives of cheerful friends, 
but do you sense a certain change 
between them? 

An R-18 romantic visual novel set at an all-boys school.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/gay-eng/work/=/product_id/RE148506.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
夏日来临。

一群快乐朋友的日常生活，
但你是否察觉到他们之间
发生了某种变化？

一部以男子学校为舞台的R-18恋爱视觉小说。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/gay-eng/work/=/product_id/RE148506.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]]
